period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2021. Income-statement items recorded here are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022 (9-month YTD); the source also independently discloses discrete 3-month (Jul-Sep 2022) figures (net loss after tax BDT -86.36m), not stored as separate line items. SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3) quality is good. The rare H1-2022 net profit recorded in 2022_Q2.json (+12.36m) reversed by this quarter: 9M-2022 cumulative is back to a net loss of -73.996m, implying a standalone Q3-2022 loss of approximately -86.36m (matching the source's own discrete-quarter column), consistent with this bank's usual loss-making pattern. Extensively cross-validated: the 9M-2021 comparative column (profit paid on deposits -329,799,995; net investment income -109,647,315; income from shares 4,479,912; commission 4,612,502; other operating income 59,162,770; total operating income -41,392,131; operating profit before provision -339,990,292; provision -30,000,000; tax 1,730,447; NOCFPS -0.15) matches 2021_Q3.json's own figures exactly (one immaterial ~1m-taka cross-report difference in the 9M-2021 operating-expenses comparative, noted but not reconciled given both readings agree to within 0.3%). Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT with D printed correctly signed as a recovery this time, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.11, all matching the filing's own Notes section).
